source.verification_notes: Official Apple technical-specification HTML archived with a SHA-256 sidecar; page identity matched 'Apple Watch Series 3'; 9 specification sections extracted. Model identity and year-introduced evidence is retained separately from Apple's identification page at https://support.apple.com/en-ie/108056.
notes: Technical specification sections are transcribed from the archived model-specific Apple Support page; every section retains its own source URL and archive path.
Model identity/year evidence is separately sourced from https://support.apple.com/en-ie/108056, archived at apple_watch_extraction/technical_specs_html/apple-watch-model-identification.html.
